fields.System.Title: INB-103 — Cancel an unreceived ASN
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to cancel an ASN for a delivery that is not coming, so that
the expected list reflects reality.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an ASN with no receipts against it, when I cancel it, then its status becomes
  • cancelled.
  • - Given an ASN that has been partly received, then cancellation is rejected — close the
  • outstanding lines short instead.
  • - Given a cancelled ASN, then no receipt can be started against it.
  • - Given the cancellation, then a reason is recorded and an event published.
